rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when people or things act, feel, or are affected in the same way or to the same degree.

example.jyutping: soeng1 baau1 toi1 lin4 siu3 seng1 dou1 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that two or more people or things are alike.

example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 daap3 on3 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this especially when the resemblance is about appearance or how something looks or sounds.

example.traditional: 呢兩個孖生仔個樣好似。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 maa1 sang1 zai2 go3 joeng2 hou2 ci5

rows.note: Use this more formal or written word for general similarity, especially in explanations or comparisons.

example.english: The basic concepts of these two theories are alike.
example.traditional: 呢兩個理論嘅基本概念相似。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 lei5 leon6 ge3 gei1 bun2 koi3 nim6 soeng1 ci5
